ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the recent Medicaid fraud investigation in Minnesota and follow the money to uncover the extent of the fraud.
questions: How much money was lost to Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and bring those responsible to justice. By following the money, we can identify the key players and track the flow of funds.
